Name: Shechem, Son of Shemidah
Summary: Son of Shemidah, named among the sons of Shemidah.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 7:19: Son of Shemidah, named among the sons of Shemidah.
LifeLesson: Named in the covenant line, Shechem stands among the individuals God placed within His people's story in 1 Chronicles.
